description:
Get NSE F&O (futures & options) positioning for one underlying.

    Accepts an NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code for a stock, OR a raw F&O underlying/index name
    (e.g. "NIFTY", "BANKNIFTY") that has no security-master row of its own.

    Returns the latest trading day's aggregate: `futures_oi`/`futures_oi_change`, `call_oi`/
    `put_oi`, `pcr` (put_oi / call_oi — a mechanically-computed ratio, not a signal),
    `total_volume`, and `in_ban_list`. Raw NSE bhavcopy figures only — no OI-buildup
    interpretation or bullish/bearish framing (SEBI-RA line).
name: get_derivatives_positioning
